business_problem: Adani Digital Labs needed to replace legacy data systems because scaling the Adani OneApp required fresher insights, better governance, and faster iteration on personalized travel and lifestyle services.
solution_summary: Adani Digital Labs uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, and Delta Lake to support real-time travel personalization and customer analytics. Adani Digital Labs needed to replace legacy data systems because scaling the Adani OneApp required fresher insights, better governance, and faster iteration on personalized travel and lifestyle services. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in Delta Lake, governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform, and delivers outputs through Databricks SQL. Customer, product, and interaction data are consolidated into Delta Lake; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Databricks SQL.
